title: Restricted Reference-ET Demand Generic-Time Runtime Binding
goal: Bind the canonically admitted stateless reference-ET demand provider to an explicit generic runtime interval and forcing-validity span without adding root-uptake, hydraulic-boundary, interception or mass-ledger composition.

contract.containment: runtime interval must be fully contained in forcing-validity span
contract.process_input: reference ET rate plus read-only canopy view and immutable ET parameters
contract.output: potential transpiration, potential soil evaporation and potential pond evaporation rates
contract.mass_semantics: potential demands are not authoritative mass withdrawals and are not integrated by this binding

ownership_decision.reason: Directly injecting the new ET provider into the existing crop_root_uptake_input_t path would create ambiguous potential-transpiration ownership. That boundary must be reconciled in a separate workunit before ptra is wired to root uptake.

qualification_requirements: arbitrary sub-day interval accepted inside a larger forcing span
interval outside forcing span rejected fail-closed
invalid interval or forcing span rejected fail-closed
exact F-PM06A/F-VQ35 process source blob preserved
rate invariance for multiple subintervals under identical forcing and canopy
no HeadCalc, Newton, Jacobian, file I/O or mass-ledger dependency
